verdict.rationale: Shared inboxes are a fair question for an email service, but nothing in the pack documents shared mailboxes, shared folders, or team views where everyone sees the same conversation state. The 'Logging in to multiple accounts' article is only a title and implies one user switching between accounts, which is an adjacent feature, not team sharing. JMAP push and sync describe protocol mechanics, not a shared-inbox feature.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state
